personality: 7 Dark-First Utility mixed with 4 Tactile / Playful component shapes
personality_one_liner: An energetic yet calm, dark-themed gamified study companion that turns exam stress into a structured, rewarding daily flight.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile padding for gamified tap targets. Consistent vertical rhythm using 8pt grid. Safe area clear padding at the bottom.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar to allow the scrolling gamified path to sit beautifully underneath
Use glass effect for bottom sheet handles and the sticky bottom CTA container
Ensure a dark tint opacity (>= 75% of #0A1420) behind the glass to maintain readability of text overlaid on the blur
dont's: Do not use glass for the flashcard body itself to maintain pure contrast
Do not apply blur to body text regions or dense analytic graphs

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A Duolingo-style queue showing the daily study review path, streak, and quick stats.

states.loading: A dark skeletal path with shimmering teal accents.
states.empty: Paper airplane mascot resting safely, stating 'Queue clear for today!' with a primary CTA to 'Scan Notes'.
states.error: Calm error message with 'Retry Connection' button.

screens.layout: RTL Layout default. Top Sticky Header: Flex-row with Goal ring, Streak counter (paper airplane icon), and XP total in brand colors. Middle: Scrollable vertical timeline/path. Nodes represent 'Decks to review today' (using surfaceSecondary with cyan active states). Bottom: Sticky floating primary CTA 'Scan & Generate Cards' centered over a glass background, above the tab bar.

screens.name: DailyReview
screens.purpose: Focus-driven flashcard study session using spaced repetition (Again/Hard/Good/Easy).

states.empty: Session complete view: celebratory paper airplane taking flight with XP gained.

screens.layout: Full screen modal/stack. Top: Thin progress bar (cyan) indicating session length (no timers). Center: A large tactile flashcard (surfaceSecondary, radius lg) taking up 60% of the screen. Tap to 3D flip. Front is question, Back is answer. Bottom: Upon flipping, a row of 4 equally weighted rounded buttons appears (Again, Hard, Good, Easy) utilizing muted tonal background chips to avoid high-stress bright red. Use subtle borderStrong on 'Good' as default recommended.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Analytics showing forgetting curves, weak subjects heatmap, and overall progress.

states.empty: No data yet; prompt to complete a review session.

screens.layout: Scrollable. Top card: Smooth line chart (forgetting curve) with neon cyan line on dark background. Middle: Weakness heatmap using tags/chips (surfaceTertiary) where darker teal indicates mastery and lighter/warning colors indicate weak Bac subjects.

screens.name: ScanAndGenerate
screens.purpose: Upload photos of notes for Gemini AI to extract and auto-generate flashcards.

states.loading: Paper airplane flying across the screen with scanning scanlines effect over the document.
states.empty: Camera viewfinder open with a framed guide.
states.error: Failed to parse text, Try again.

screens.layout: Viewfinder taking top 70%. Bottom sheet containing 'Capture' button and 'Gallery' icon. Post-capture, transition to a preview list of generated flashcards with edit/save icons.

hero_paper_airplane.alt: Paper airplane over dark blue background

student_studying.alt: Student studying in a dark room

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme: surface must be #0A1420 and brand primary #2DD4E8. Ensure WCAG contrast between secondary text (#C9EEFA) and the dark backgrounds.
Implement I18nManager.forceRTL(true) early in the setup as the default UI language is Arabic. Ensure all flex-row layouts implicitly reverse correctly or are explicitly mapped for RTL support.
For the gamified Duolingo-style 'Home' screen, use a vertical node path. Center the nodes and connect them with vertical lines. Use Phosphor icons inside circular nodes.
For the 'DailyReview' flashcard screen, utilize react-native-reanimated for a smooth 3D flip card animation. When flipped, fade-in the 4 Spaced Repetition (SM-2) buttons.
Keep the tone calm—avoid harsh reds for 'Again/Hard' buttons. Instead, use surfaceTertiary chips with subtle muted colored text or borders.
Do NOT use indigo, violet, or pure navy blue beyond the specified #0A1420 and #152336 background hues.
Incorporate the paper-airplane mascot natively using Phosphor 'PaperPlaneRight' icon for the streak counter and loading transitions.
Use Nunito for headings (bold, rounded, friendly) and Plus Jakarta Sans for high legibility body text.
All interactive elements (cards, bottom sheet) must use large tactile radii (md: 16, lg: 24).
